`pattern_fit`: A (three gated HTTP entry points plus initialize-time state plumbing in one file; O2 `none`, O8 empty).
Strongest lever: O5/O7 — the Origin has to be captured in `handle_initialization` (`:685,708-712`) while the no-Origin-client and stateless exemptions must survive, so the tempting tight fix (require Origin, gate only regular POSTs) breaks legitimate clients and misses notification/response/GET/DELETE.
Biggest red flag: `tiny_repo` (size inferred, not measured — ~156 files, one 1.1k-line source file and one 4.9k-line test file).
